name: Fern ~Dakara Kimi no Koto~
source:
The protagonist has just been accepted into a university in Hokkaido, and in two weeks he’ll leave behind his familiar home town to commute there. 

His father has been out of the country due to work, and he has been in charge of the house along with his step-sister. His impending departure has made him think about her in ways he never has before. And his step-sister, who has long had feelings for him, has become more proactive...

In just two short weeks many exciting stories will unfold between him, classmates, teachers, and the girl he admires. At the center of it all is his relationship with his step-sister.

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1015]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公刚被北海道的一所大学录取，再过两周，他就要离开熟悉的故乡，前往那里上学。

父亲因工作常年在国外，主人公一直和继妹一起操持家务。临行在即，他开始以从未有过的方式注视这位继妹。而一直对他怀有感情的继妹，也变得更加主动……

短短两周里，他与同学、老师以及自己仰慕的女孩之间，将展开许多令人心动的故事。其中最核心的，仍是他与继妹之间的关系。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1015]Getchu.com[/url]的简介]
